decisions.reason: Names PID 42432 dsh web host as the process that loaded @koromix/koffi at startup; Windows keeps mapped native image locked until process exit, npm copyfile hits EBUSY.

Refresh/tab close only reload the Web Client; ordered procedure: confirm published, stop all dsh processes, verify gone, external-terminal pinned install, restart dsh web then hard refresh; scoped to dsh processes, not all Node.

Bare name resolves via latest = 0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha holds 0.1.2-alpha.5; global install replaces installed alpha.4 with rc.2 rather than preserving/upgrading; explicitly states unpinned install does not preserve installed version.

Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 then separate pinned dsh-tui install after stopping host, dsh --version must print 0.1.2-alpha.5, restart host; @alpha discussed only as floating non-pin alternative.

README rules: pin exact tested host version, never unpinned or combined host+plugin command, explain latest may lag and silently downgrade a prerelease, add stop-host and dsh --version verification steps.
